physiological_equivalent_description: Resting internal jugular cross-section implied by the fitted tube-law stiffness. STREAMED AS QUALITY CONTROL, NOT AS A DIAGNOSIS: Model_6/structural_diagnosis shows the fit drives this to 5-12 cm2 (about 205 mL of jugular) which is roughly ten times physiological, and that this artefact is what causes the model's ICP pulse-amplitude failure. A bedside ultrasound falsifies it in thirty seconds. Read a value outside the healthy band as evidence the FIT is wrong, not that the patient is.
bound_source: supine IJV cross-section ~0.8-2.0 cm2; posture- and respiration-dependent
caveat: No healthy controls exist in this dataset - all four recordings are ICU patients. Healthy bounds are from literature, not from a control group measured with this pipeline.
